item.description: Delivery Services Crippled as Gig Workers Strike for Fair Pay and Safety. item.description: On New Year’s Day, Bulgaria becomes the 21st country to join the euro currency union, furthering its integration into the European Union. item.title: Suneel Anchipaka takes charge of DTTDC
item.description: Suneel Anchipaka, IAS, has been given the additional charge of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Delhi Tourism and Transportation Development Corporation (DTTDC). item.title: Ahmedabad Flower Show begins with ‘Bharat: Ek Gatha’ theme
item.description: The Amdavad Municipal Corporation (AMC) will host the annual International Flower Show at the Sabarmati Riverfront from January 1 to 25.
